visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens inside a home where a ginger and white cat sits on a person's lap; the camera shakes violently as text overlays mention an earthquake in Taipei. A person's hand reaches out to pet the cat's back to provide comfort. (2) The shot cuts to a white hanging lamp in a dining area swinging intensely from side to side due to the tremors. (3) Back on the lap, the cat looks around with wide eyes and alert ears as the person continues petting its back. (4) The cat suddenly jumps off the lap and scurries across the bed toward the door. (5) An older man wearing an orange long-sleeved shirt and shorts is seen holding onto the swinging dining lamp to stabilize it. (6) The camera moves to show the cat hiding on a shelf underneath a wooden dining table, looking out with extremely dilated pupils. (7) Close-up shots focus on the cat's face as it remains frozen under the table. (8) The final scene shows the cat sitting on a black glass table in front of a television screen displaying earthquake news reports.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with loud, low-frequency rumbling and a metallic thud as the environment shakes. A female voice exclaims in a high-pitched, panicked tone, repeating 'Oh my god' and describing the intensity. (2) As the rumbling continues, the female voice shifts to a softer but strained pitch, trying to comfort the cat by saying its name, 'Uni,' while breathing heavily. (3) A sudden rustling sound and footsteps occur as the cat jumps. A male voice enters with a moderate, slightly excited narrative pitch, describing the dangerous 'up and down' motion of the quake. (4) The scene transitions to the dining area where the female voice identifies the cat's hiding spot with a bright, relieved intonation. The male voice makes a rhythmic, joking remark about the situation, followed by a faint laugh. (5) In the final phase, background audio from a television news broadcast is heard with a professional, enunciated reporting style, overlaying the casual conversation of the residents.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a real-life experience of a significant earthquake in Taipei, focusing on the immediate panic and the subsequent reaction of a pet cat. It captures the chaos through shaky handheld footage and then transitions into a lighthearted observation of the cat's 'survival instincts' as it hides in a safe place, ultimately reassuring viewers of their safety.
